verdict.rationale: ADK's first-party docs and repo document multi-agent orchestration inside one workflow. A Workflow Runtime provides graph-based routing, fan-out/fan-in, loops and nested workflows. A Task API provides structured agent-to-agent delegation with task agents usable as workflow nodes. The docs state that any app with more than one agent is a workflow. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-agent orchestration in practice.

support.subject: As a developer, I can orchestrate multiple agents — handoffs, subagents, or crews — inside one workflow

citations.quote: workflows, which allow you to combine and orchestrate multiple agents and code execution tasks
Task API: Structured agent-to-agent delegation with multi-turn task mode, single-turn controlled output, mixed delegation patterns, human-in-the-loop, and task agents as workflow nodes.

Workflow Runtime: A graph-based execution engine for composing deterministic execution flows for agentic apps, with support for routing, fan-out/fan-in, loops, retry, state management, dynamic nodes, human-in-the-loop, and nested workflows.
In ADK, any agent application that has more than one agent or executable Node is considered a workflow.
